payload.reason: The evidence provides specific modifications made to post-trained BERT, particularly the application of adversarial training to improve its performance in Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis tasks.

claims.text: Adversarial training is applied to post-trained BERT to enhance its performance in Aspect Extraction and Aspect Sentiment Classification tasks.
A novel architecture called BERT Adversarial Training (BAT) is proposed, which outperforms post-trained BERT in the mentioned tasks.
The model's performance is improved by utilizing adversarial examples during training, which regularizes the neural network.
